At APETECH Solutions (May 2025 – Oct. 2026) I delivered core workflows for Americano, a ~36-branch F&B chain, court booking and tournament brackets for D-Joy Pickleball (3 large court clusters in Saigon), and a multi-tenant PMS SaaS.
